title: Fix toString error on country selection

requirements.summary: Fix the 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading toString)' error that occurs when a country is selected in the VAT calculator flow
acceptanceCriteria: Country selection completes without throwing toString errors
User can successfully proceed through the calculator flow after selecting a country
All country selection components handle undefined/null values gracefully

file_operations.description: Add null/undefined checks before any toString() calls on country objects. Ensure country data is validated before rendering country buttons. Add defensive guards around country code access and display logic.
Add null/undefined validation for country data before rendering the country grid. Ensure VAT rate access uses optional chaining and provides fallback values when rates are undefined.

Add defensive checks for country-specific VAT information access. Use optional chaining when accessing VAT rates and country configuration data. Handle cases where country details may be undefined or incomplete.

Add type guards and validation to country lookup functions. Ensure all functions that return country data handle missing entries gracefully and return safe default values or null instead of undefined. Add explicit null checks before any data transformations.

Add defensive null/undefined checks in the country config retrieval function. Ensure the function returns a safe fallback structure when country data is missing. Validate country codes before lookup operations.

requirements.summary: Add defensive null/undefined checks in VAT calculation and country selection logic to prevent similar runtime errors
acceptanceCriteria: All country-related data access uses optional chaining or explicit null checks
VAT rate lookups handle missing country data safely
Currency formatting functions validate input before calling toString()

file_operations.description: Add null/undefined guards before accessing country configuration and VAT rates. Validate input parameters at function entry points and provide safe fallbacks for missing data. Use optional chaining when accessing nested country properties.

Add explicit null checks before VAT rate calculations. Ensure all country and category lookups validate their results before proceeding. Use optional chaining when accessing rate data and provide default values when rates are undefined.

Add input validation to all currency formatting functions before calling toString() on numeric values. Check that amount parameters are defined and valid numbers before formatting. Use optional chaining when accessing currency configuration from country data.

Add null/undefined validation for country and VAT rate data before rendering form fields. Ensure VAT ID validation handles undefined country codes gracefully. Use optional chaining when accessing country-specific configuration.

Add validation for all input parameters before constructing the backend payload. Ensure country codes are defined and valid before normalization. Add null checks before accessing nested properties in the form state.

Add robust null/undefined handling in URL parameter parsing. Ensure country code validation returns safe error states instead of allowing undefined values to propagate. Add explicit checks before country code normalization operations.
